title: The Knight
summary: A tricky L-shaped jump — meet the knight.

steps.text: The KNIGHT jumps in an L-shape! Two squares one way, then one square sideways — and it can hop right over other pieces.

steps.prompt: Hop the knight to f5 — two up, one right.
steps.retryText: Try the L-shape: two squares up, one square right, landing on f5.

steps.prompt: Now hop to c6 — one left, two up.
steps.retryText: Try one square left, two squares up, landing on c6.

steps.prompt: Try hopping down to e2 — one right, two down.
steps.successText: You're getting the hang of the knight's hop!
steps.retryText: Try one square right, two squares down, landing on e2.

steps.prompt: The knight can jump right over the pawn on d5! Land on f5 to capture the other pawn.
steps.successText: Hop, skip, and capture! Knights are sneaky.
steps.retryText: Jump over the pawn on d5 and land on f5 to capture.

steps.text: Knights are the only piece that can jump over others. Next: the king — the most important piece of all!
